purpose: Validate the probe-.17 counter-0-only +500 us scheduler experiment while preserving the accepted probe-.15 carrier, calibrated prelude, payload, branch selection, and retained stock identity.
interpretation: The valve gesture occurred inside both the five-minute node arm window and the dedicated continuous IQ capture.
The selected node heard the factory sweep through counter 3 and transmitted the structurally correct selector-5 and selector-6 assignments.
The counter-0 assignment began 50.800 ms after the factory request ended, only about 0.25 ms later than the accepted stock 50.55 ms observation.
The valve emitted no addressed stage-1 request after either assignment and therefore rejected both branches at the first enrollment boundary.
A small counter-0 scheduler mismatch is no longer a useful leading hypothesis; preserve this evidence and do not create probe .18 without a new discriminator from stock/local comparison.
